address.scope: reserved domain of your ngrok account
conditions: a reserved domain is a per-user setup value
the listener lives only while the host process runs

cost.summary: ngrok has a $0 Free plan with one development domain, but its pricing page says custom domains need Pay-as-you-go ($20 base).

disclosure.text: Serve this app through an ngrok listener on your reserved ngrok domain while the app runs. The ngrok edge terminates TLS and can read payloads. The auth token stays in Gozar’s private store.

protocols.sse/streamableHttp: false. no admitted recipe: this adapter runs no recipe probe, so no timed stream probe gates a publication
protocols.oauthDcr: sse/streamableHttp false: the SDK listener path runs no timed stream probe before publication (recipe-blocked). oauthDcr: the reserved domain is a stable HTTPS origin and the configured authority is preserved.
